mapper.select: WITH calendar AS ( SELECT day::date AS report_date FROM generate_series(CAST(#{fromDate} AS date), CAST(#{toDate} AS date), interval '1 day') day ), fleet_daily AS ( SELECT c.report_date, count(v.vehicle_id) AS deployed_vehicles FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON v.operation_city_code = #{cityCode} AND v.launch_date <= c.report_date AND v.lifecycle_status IN ('OPERATING', 'DISPATCHING') GROUP BY c.report_date ), order_metrics AS ( SELECT coalesce(sum(gross_amount) FILTER (WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED'), 0) AS gross_bookings, coalesce(sum(discount_amount) FILTER (WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED'), 0) AS discount_amount, coalesce(sum(refund_amount) FILTER (WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED'), 0) AS refund_amount, coalesce(sum(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED'), 0) AS net_revenue, count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED') AS completed_rides, count(DISTINCT vehicle_id) FILTER (WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED') AS active_vehicles, coalesce(sum(duration_seconds) FILTER (WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED'), 0) AS duration_seconds, coalesce(sum(distance_meters) FILTER (WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED'), 0) AS distance_meters FROM ride_order WHERE city_code = #{cityCode} AND started_at >= #{fromInstant} AND started_at < #{toInstant} ) SELECT o.*, coalesce(sum(f.deployed_vehicles), 0) AS vehicle_days FROM order_metrics o CROSS JOIN fleet_daily f GROUP BY o.gross_bookings, o.discount_amount, o.refund_amount, o.net_revenue, o.completed_rides, o.active_vehicles, o.duration_seconds, o.distance_meters

WITH calendar AS ( SELECT day::date AS report_date FROM generate_series(CAST(#{fromDate} AS date), CAST(#{toDate} AS date), interval '1 day') day ), fleet_daily AS ( SELECT c.report_date, 'DISPATCHING') GROUP BY c.report_date ), periods AS ( SELECT DISTINCT AS period_start FROM calendar c ), fleet_metrics AS ( SELECT AS period_start, sum(f.deployed_vehicles) AS vehicle_days FROM fleet_daily f JOIN calendar c ON c.report_date = f.report_date GROUP BY period_start ), order_metrics AS ( SELECT AS period_start, coalesce(sum(gross_amount) FILTER (WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED'), 0) AS gross_bookings, coalesce(sum(discount_amount) FILTER (WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED'), 0) AS discount_amount, coalesce(sum(refund_amount) FILTER (WHERE order_status <> coalesce(sum(distance_meters) FILTER (WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED'), 0) AS distance_meters FROM ride_order WHERE city_code = #{cityCode} AND started_at >= #{fromInstant} AND started_at < #{toInstant} GROUP BY period_start ) SELECT p.period_start, coalesce(o.gross_bookings, 0) AS gross_bookings, coalesce(o.discount_amount, 0) AS discount_amount, coalesce(o.refund_amount, 0) AS refund_amount, coalesce(o.net_revenue, 0) AS net_revenue, coalesce(o.completed_rides, 0) AS completed_rides, coalesce(o.active_vehicles, 0) AS active_vehicles, coalesce(o.duration_seconds, 0) AS duration_seconds, coalesce(o.distance_meters, 0) AS distance_meters, coalesce(f.vehicle_days, 0) AS vehicle_days FROM periods p LEFT JOIN order_metrics o ON o.period_start = p.period_start LEFT JOIN fleet_metrics f ON f.period_start = p.period_start ORDER BY p.period_start
